name: Happy Set: Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul

line.name: Happy Set: Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul

releases.name: Happy Set: Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul

description.text:
The Happy Set Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul (宝可梦卡牌 嗨皮组合 皮卡丘&皮皮&草苗龟&索财灵) came out on 17 January 2025 with Eternal Birth, as a box for friends to play together. It held four ready-to-play 60-card decks, built around Pikachu ex, Clefable ex, Torterra and Gholdengo, each with a card explaining how it plays, plus a beginner's guide, battle guides, damage counters and two coins. With the decks came rules for two to four players, a 10-card modification pack for changing a deck after a lost game, a one-card reward pack for the winner and seven Collect 151 event packs to share out. With luck one of the four decks was a holo deck, the same cards in holo, which turned up 1.6% of the time. A Happy Deck (嗨皮卡组) box holding one of the four decks at random came out the same day.

Each card carries a small silhouette of its deck's Pokémon. From 18 January 2025 shops held Happy Battle (嗨皮大对决) events with the decks. Its cards are numbered out of 59; four basic Energy print their type code instead of a number.
